narrative_purpose: This figure puts the symbiosis spectrum on one reef scene: a Na'vi diver wearing a living Gill Mantle, a small fish sheltering harmlessly in a coral, and a mimic darting in to bite a client — so the reader sees partnership run from mutual benefit through commensalism to outright cheating.
subject: A single reef scene holding three relationships. Foreground: a slender blue Na'vi diver underwater with a soft living mantle-organism spread across their chest and back, a fine tendril joining it to the diver's neural queue, the diver calm and breathing easily. Mid-ground: a small fish resting unharmed deep inside a branching coral colony, sheltered but taking nothing from it. Background right: two similar-looking small fish at a cleaning spot, one of them lunging to nip the flank of a larger fish that flinches — a cheat among honest cleaners.
scene: A sunlit Pandoran reef shallow with branching growths, the three interactions spread across foreground to background.
camera: Medium reef view with the diver and mantle largest in the foreground, the sheltering fish mid-ground, the cleaning-cheat scene smaller in the background.
light: Cool teal daylight with cyan bioluminescence along the reef and a faint living-teal glow where the mantle joins the diver's queue.
palette: Ocean teal and void indigo dominant, cyan and living-teal glows, blue Na'vi skin, one small magenta or amber accent on the cheating fish.
style: Hand-painted speculative-biology naturalist plate, textured and observed, quietly narrative.
detail_level: High detail on the diver-and-mantle bond and the two fish interactions; open water between them kept plain for callouts.
composition: Three clearly separated interactions arranged front-to-back on one reef, generous dark or plain water beside each for annotation.
consistency_notes: The Gill Mantle is a soft living organism worn on the body joined to the queue, not a manufactured diving rig. Na'vi is reef-adapted and blue. Match reef palette and creature look to the other figures. Keep plain water beside each of the three interactions for labels.
negative_prompt: no text, no labels, no numbers, no arrows, no mechanical scuba gear, no flat vector infographic, no photographic or CGI look, no cartoon style
